content: The prescribed dosage is 5 mg/kg administered intravenously every 12 hours for a minimum of 7 days. Refer to the administration guidelines for intravenous preparation and infusion rates. Quinupristin/dalfopristin interacts with various drugs by altering hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism, leading to increased or decreased drug levels and effects. Below are specific interactions and recommendations: 1. Lonafarnib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases lonafarnib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated as lonafarnib is a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate. Avoid combining with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 2. Amiodarone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases amiodarone levels by reducing its metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated due to the risk of prolonged QTc interval. 3. Avapritinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases avapritinib levels. Avoid co-administration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. If unavoidable, reduce the starting dose of avapritinib and refer to dosage modification guidelines. 4. Live Bacterial Vaccines (e.g., BCG, Cholera, Typhoid): Quinupristin/dalfopristin reduces the efficacy of live bacterial vaccines through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Wait until antibiotic treatment is complete before administering live vaccines. 5. Clarithromycin: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases clarithromycin levels by reducing its metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated due to the risk of QTc prolongation. 6. Dihydroergotamine (including intranasal): Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases dihydroergotamine levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 7. Dronedarone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases dronedarone levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 8. Elacestrant: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases elacestrant levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 9. Encorafenib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases encorafenib levels. If co-administration with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor is unavoidable, reduce the encorafenib dose by half. Resume the previous dose after discontinuing the inhibitor for 3-5 elimination half-lives. 10. Entrectinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases entrectinib levels. Avoid co-administration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Resume the previous dose after discontinuing the inhibitor for 3-5 elimination half-lives. 11. Ergotamine: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases ergotamine levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 12. Erythromycin (all forms): Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases erythromycin levels by reducing its metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated due to the risk of QTc prolongation. 13. Everolimus: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases everolimus levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 14. Finerinone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases finerinone levels. Monitor serum potassium during initiation and dosage adjustments. Adjust finerinone dosage as needed. 15. Haloperidol: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases haloperidol levels by reducing its metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated due to the risk of QTc prolongation. 16. Ibrutinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases ibrutinib levels. Avoid co-administration or reduce the ibrutinib dose to 280 mg daily for B-cell malignancies or 420 mg daily for graft-versus-host disease. Resume the previous dose after discontinuing the inhibitor. 17. Infigratinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases infigratinib levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 18. Lemborexant: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases lemborexant levels. Avoid co-administration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 19. Lovastatin: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases lovastatin levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 20. Lurbinectedin: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases lurbinectedin levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 21. Microbiota Oral: Quinupristin/dalfopristin reduces the efficacy of microbiota oral therapy by pharmacodynamic antagonism. Complete antibiotic regimens 2-4 days before initiating microbiota oral therapy. 22. Midazolam (intranasal): Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases midazolam levels, potentially prolonging sedation. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 23. Neratinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases neratinib levels. Avoid co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 24. Omaeveloxolone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases omaeveloxolone levels. If unavoidable, reduce the dose to 100 mg daily and monitor for adverse effects. Further reduce to 50 mg daily if necessary. 25. Pacritinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases pacritinib levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 26. Pazopanib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases pazopanib levels. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. If unavoidable, reduce the pazopanib dose to 400 mg daily. 27. Pexidartinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases pexidartinib levels. Avoid co-administration or reduce the dose as per drug monograph guidelines. 28. Pimozide: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases pimozide levels by reducing its metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated due to the risk of QT prolongation. 29. Ranolazine: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases ranolazine levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 30. Red Yeast Rice: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases red yeast rice levels, potentially increasing the risk of myopathy or rhabdomyolysis. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 31. Repotrectinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases repotrectinib levels. Avoid co-administration or discontinue CYP3A inhibitors for 3-5 elimination half-lives before initiating repotrectinib. 32. Selumetinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases selumetinib levels. If co-administration is unavoidable, reduce the selumetinib dosage as per the drug monograph. 33. Silodosin: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases silodosin levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 34. Simvastatin: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases simvastatin levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 35. Siponimod: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases siponimod levels. Avoid co-administration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors combined with CYP2C9 inhibitors. 36. Sirolimus: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases sirolimus levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 37. Tazemetostat: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases tazemetostat levels. Avoid co-administration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. If unavoidable, reduce the tazemetostat dose as per the drug monograph. 38. Tolvaptan: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases tolvaptan levels. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 39. Vilazodone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases vilazodone levels. Reduce the daily dose to 20 mg when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 40. Acalabrutinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases acalabrutinib levels. Reduce the dose to 100 mg once daily if co-administered with a moderate CYP3A inhibitor. 41. Almotriptan: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases almotriptan levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 42. Alprazolam: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases alprazolam levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 43. Amiodarone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases amiodarone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 44. Aprepitant: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases aprepitant levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 45. Aripiprazole: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases aripiprazole levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 46. Artemether/Lumefantrine: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases artemether/lumefantrine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 47. Atogepant: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases atogepant levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 48. Atorvastatin: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases atorvastatin levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 49. Avanafil: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases avanafil levels. Reduce the maximum dose to 50 mg once every 24 hours when co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 50. Bazedoxifene/Conjugated Estrogens: Quinupristin/dalfopristin alters intestinal flora, potentially reducing or increasing hormone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 51. Bortezomib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases bortezomib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 52. Budesonide: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases budesonide levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 53. Buprenorphine (Subdermal Implant): Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases buprenorphine levels. Monitor for signs of overmedication. Implant removal may be necessary if dose adjustments are not feasible. 54. Buprenorphine (Long-Acting Injection): Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases buprenorphine levels. Monitor plasma levels and transition to an adjustable dosage form if toxicity occurs. 55. Buspirone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases buspirone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 56. Cannabidiol: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cannabidiol levels. Consider reducing the cannabidiol dose when co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 57. Capivasertib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases capivasertib levels. Reduce the dose if co-administered with moderate CYP3A inhibitors. 58. Carbamazepine: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases carbamazepine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 59. Cilostazol: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cilostazol levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 60. Cinacalcet: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cinacalcet levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 61. Clopidogrel: Quinupristin/dalfopristin reduces clopidogrel bioactivation. Use caution and monitor closely. 62. Clozapine: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases clozapine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 63. Conivaptan: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases conivaptan levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 64. Conjugated Estrogens: Quinupristin/dalfopristin alters intestinal flora, potentially reducing or increasing hormone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 65. Cortisone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cortisone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 66. Cyclosporine: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cyclosporine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 67. Daridorexant: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases daridorexant levels. Limit the dose to 25 mg per night when co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 68. Darifenacin: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases darifenacin levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 69. Darunavir: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases darunavir levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 70. Dasatinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases dasatinib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 71. Deflazacort: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases deflazacort levels. Reduce the dose to one-third of the recommended dose when co-administered with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 72. Dexamethasone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases dexamethasone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 73. Diazepam (all forms): Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases diazepam levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 74. Dienogest/Estradiol Valerate: Quinupristin/dalfopristin alters intestinal flora, potentially reducing hormone levels. Use caution and consider additional contraceptive methods. 75. Digoxin: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases digoxin levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 76. Diltiazem: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases diltiazem levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 77. Eletriptan: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases eletriptan levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 78. Erlotinib: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases erlotinib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 79. Estradiol: Quinupristin/dalfopristin alters intestinal flora, potentially reducing or increasing hormone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 80. Estrogens (all forms): Quinupristin/dalfopristin alters intestinal flora, potentially reducing or increasing hormone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 81. Ethinylestradiol: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases ethinylestradiol levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 82. Etonogestrel: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases etonogestrel levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 83. Etravirine: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases etravirine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 84. Felodipine: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases felodipine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 85. Fesoterodine: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases fesoterodine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 86. Fludrocortisone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases fludrocortisone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 87. Fosamprenavir: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases fosamprenavir levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 88. Fosaprepitant: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases fosaprepitant levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 89. Gepirone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases gepirone levels. Reduce the dose by 50% when co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 90. Guanfacine: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases guanfacine levels. Reduce the dose to half the recommended dose for extended-release formulations. Specific recommendations for immediate-release formulations are unavailable. 91. Hydrocortisone: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases hydrocortisone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 92. Hydroxyprogesterone Caproate: Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases hydroxyprogesterone caproate levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 93. Ifosfamide: Quinupristin/dalfopristin decreases ifosfamide levels. Use caution and monitor closely. This list highlights the importance of monitoring and adjusting dosages when quinupristin/dalfopristin is co-administered with other medications. Always consult specific drug monographs for detailed recommendations.
